_comment: Properties of a front-panel control or indicator that a Property Node bound to a control of the VI may write while the VI runs (plan section 10). A row is identified by its PropItemCode, never its stored name. 'inherited' holds the codes every control class shares; 'classes' holds a class's own codes (a class entry wins over an inherited one with the same code). Each entry: 'name' is NI's long name, 'member' the Python name, 'value' the kind of value written (bool, enum, number), 'doc_url' NI's public page for the property. 'value_codes' lists the codes of the property that reads or writes a control's value (the Value row), by the same inherited-then-class rule. A property is listed only when NI's page says what it does. 'reference_rows' lists the rows a Property Node on a wired control reference (a Ctl, Clust, Bool ... reference) reads or writes as the reference's own value, indicator flag or label text: each row's 'codes' are the property paths (one code per segment) the corpus records for it; 'value' adds the generic Value code to 'value_codes' (a strict class's own code, 104013842, is already there).
